notes:
Refers specifically to the formal process of making peace between nations or groups that have been at war. Often encountered in historical contexts, particularly regarding the San Francisco Peace Treaty (サンフランシスコ{講和|こうわ}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講和|こうわ}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧: peace treaty
- {講和|こうわ}⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: peace negotiations
- {講和|こうわ}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: peace conference
- {講和|こうわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧: peace is established
- {講和|こうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to conclude peace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和平|わへい}: peace — broader term for peaceful resolution, not limited to formal treaties
- ⟦{停戦|ていせん}→停戦：24539_teisen⟧: ceasefire — temporary halt in fighting, not the formal end of conflict
- ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧: peace — general state of peace, not the process of achieving it
